Accuracy notes

  • Vintage Gold Star cards print a hollow foil star with two trailing sparkle dots right after the name. Japan replaced picture symbols with letter codes in December 2010, so these cards have no letter code.
  • Mega Hyper Rare is MUR in Japanese and Mega Attack Rare is MA.
  • Hyper Rare stars are stacked in a triangle, and two star marks are offset and overlapping, as printed.
  • Radiant Rare prints a single solid white star.
  • Futuristic Rare stars change color to match the card; Japanese prints use the letters FUR.

Reading the stamps

Modern colored stars carry a thin white keyline. Black symbols are shown on a card stock swatch so they read the way they do in the bottom corner of a real card. Pull rates vary by set and language; ranks reflect typical modern English booster odds.
